body:
# ★ Aim Mark Star Pack

Tired of the boring default crosshair? **Aim Mark Star Pack** replaces it with a smooth animated spinning star — because your aim deserves to look legendary.

---

## ✦ Features
- ⭐ Animated 5-pointed star crosshair
- 🔄 16-frame smooth rotation animation
- ⚡ Lightweight — zero performance impact
- 🎯 Clean white star on transparent background
- ✅ Compatible with Minecraft 1.20+

## ✦ Installation
1. Download the `.zip` file
2. Go to **Options → Resource Packs** in Minecraft
3. Drag and drop the pack into the window
4. Enable it and you're good to go!

## ✦ Compatibility
- Works with most other resource packs
- No mods required — vanilla compatible
